query.sql:
SELECT
  scope.passages AS passages,
  scope.questions AS questions,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE decision.disposition = 'quarantine') AS quarantined,
  expertReview.answerAgreement.matches AS expertMatches,
  expertReview.answerAgreement.total AS expertTotal,
  expertReview.keyConflictCount AS keyConflicts
FROM read_json_auto('output/audits/ielts-reading-rights-tfng-2026-08-09/validation.json') AS report,
UNNEST(report.decisions) AS rows(decision)
GROUP BY ALL;

SELECT
  decision.assetId,
  decision.title,
  decision.wordCount,
  decision.questionCount,
  decision.provenanceStatus,
  decision.rightsBasis,
  decision.factualReviewStatus,
  decision.humanReviewStatus,
  decision.disposition,
  array_to_string(decision.reasonCodes, ' · ') AS blockers
FROM read_json_auto('output/audits/ielts-reading-rights-tfng-2026-08-09/validation.json') AS report,
UNNEST(report.decisions) AS rows(decision);

blocks.body: # IELTS Reading True / False / Not Given — audit gate

## Executive Summary

- The F0.2b.2 control passes; the 3 passages do not. All remain quarantined.
- Independent review covered 22/22 statements and challenged 3 stored key decisions.
- The absolute-language shortcut is eligible on 10 statements and matches FALSE on 8; content certification remains blocked.
- UI/UX and Playwright are outside this audit slice because all four learner-facing hashes are unchanged.

## The control passes; the bank is not cleared

Object and passage hashes pin identity, incomplete rights records fail closed, and candidate evidence is separated from factual verification. None of this supplies authorship, a license, a human signature or learner-outcome evidence. Quarantine is the only valid disposition.

## NOT GIVEN must mean absent, not merely imprecise

The independent reviewer fixed all decisions before seeing factual sources. Conflicts with the stored bank: tfng-urban-trees-05, tfng-libraries-05, tfng-coastal-03. The validator requires a decisive passage span for TRUE/FALSE, but for NOT GIVEN it requires a related zone plus the exact missing fact. This prevents a reviewer from inventing positive evidence for absence.

## Quantifiers create a visible shortcut

FALSE is stored for 11 of 22 statements. The simple rule “absolute word → FALSE” answers only 10 items but gets 8 of those right (80%). That is too predictive for editorial certification even though the sample remains too small for a statistical fairness claim.

## Factual support and case identity remain separate risks

Urban sources may support general heat/canopy claims without proving the passage wording. The school and coastal candidates do not establish that the narrated cases occurred as written. Untraceable cases must be declared synthetic/composite or replaced; no candidate source becomes a factual or rights approval automatically.

## The content exposes useful learning targets

The clean walkthrough traces likely confusion between contradiction and missing information, plus scope, time, comparison and prior knowledge. Its value is diagnostic only: it does not assign answers or bands and does not represent a real learner study.

## Panel scope

Applicable lanes pass only when the dossier is complete, conservative and reproducible. UI/UX and Playwright are marked not applicable for this slice by unchanged hashes, not by convenience. No lane certifies learner-facing conformity, copyright clearance or publication readiness.

## Recommended next decisions

1. Correct every independently identified key conflict before any learner-facing release.
2. Remove the quantifier shortcut by writing credible TRUE and NOT GIVEN items that also contain absolute-looking language where semantically justified.
3. Resolve authorship, rights, exact-case provenance and human factual review for all three passages.
4. Keep F0.2b open; begin F0.2b.3 only in the next loop iteration.

## Caveats and open questions

The provenance search was directed and non-exhaustive. Source reachability is not verification. Both independent reviews are AI simulations without human signatures. The 22-question sample cannot certify statistical fairness. Runtime quarantine enforcement, the visible originality claim and learner UI remain separate open units.

audit.scope: Dossier completeness and conservative disposition; not copyright clearance.
audit.findings: Three of three assets remain unknown-quarantined. A directed non-exhaustive provenance ledger and eight candidate-source fetch records do not establish authorship, ownership or authorization.
audit.blockersCarriedForward: Authorship, rights basis, license or authorization evidence, and independent human approval remain unresolved.

audit.scope: Identity, fail-closed registry decisions, blind packets, first-pass trace and deterministic validation.
audit.findings: Object and passage hashes match baseline and registry; malformed or changed records quarantine. Key-like leakage is scanned in names and values, including an adversarial text-value control.
audit.blockersCarriedForward: The local first-pass hash is not an external append-only witness; runtime quarantine enforcement belongs to a later unit.

audit.scope: Complete independent audit of answerability and IELTS fitness; not bank certification.
audit.findings: The clean reviewer covered 22 of 22 statements, matched 19 stored keys, refuted three stored decisions and identified two material ambiguities under the official contradiction-versus-absence rule.
audit.blockersCarriedForward: The bank remains blocked until miskeys and ambiguous urban items are rewritten and independently re-adjudicated.

audit.scope: Prospective content-only simulation, not a real learner or UI study.
audit.findings: Three passages and 22 statements have likely misread, evidence hunt, decision rule and repair action recorded without assigned answers or bands.
audit.blockersCarriedForward: No claim of retention, band improvement, accessibility, usability or effectiveness with real students.

audit.scope: Detection and blocking, not statistical fairness certification.
audit.findings: Stored labels are 7 TRUE, 11 FALSE and 4 NOT GIVEN. Always choosing FALSE scores 50%; the absolute-language cue hits 8 of 10 eligible items. Sequence, length, lexical overlap, per-set balance and qualitative risks are recorded.
audit.blockersCarriedForward: n=22 is below the certification threshold; contentCertification stays blocked-key-and-shortcut-review-required.

audit.scope: Not applicable to the learner-facing delta of F0.2b.2 only.
audit.findings: Catalog, route, ObjectivePracticeEngine and ObjectivePracticeSetBank hashes are unchanged; no app or component imports the audit registry or contract.
audit.blockersCarriedForward: This does not certify the existing UI, accessibility, Task 2 parity, shared layouts or product-wide behavior.

audit.scope: Not applicable because this audit-only unit introduces no scoped DOM, copy, interaction or runtime delta.
audit.findings: The N/A decision is guarded by four baseline hashes and absence of audit imports in learner-facing app/component sources.
audit.blockersCarriedForward: No browser matrix, screenshots, traces or viewport evidence exists for this row, so it must never be represented as Playwright PASS.
